interactions.note: CR1 scFv was obtained by selecting yeast displayed mutants of the humanized affinity-matured AR2 scFv  by increasing the affinity for BoNT/A2, while maintaining high affinity binding to BoNT/A1. Compared to AR2, CR1 has three amino acid substitutions in CDR H1 (S30>K, D31>Y, H32>D) and a single amino acid substitution in CDR H2 (P61>S). CR1 scFv was obtained by selecting yeast-displayed mutants of the humanized affinity-matured AR2 scFv by increasing the affinity for BoNT/A2, while maintaining high affinity binding to BoNT/A1. The scFV KD to BoNT/A1 is 0.125 nM  and to BoNT/A2 is 0.4nM.  The ratio of affinities towards both subtypes was maintained when the scFv was converted to IgG.

AR2 scFv was obtained by selecting yeast-displayed mutants of the humanized C25 mAb by increasing the affinity for BoNT/A1.  AR2 binds BoNT/A1 with very high affinity and exhibits the highest level of in vivo neutralization, but has minimal neutralizing activity for BoNT/A2. The scFV KD to BoNT/A1 is 0.136 nM and to BoNT/A2 is 109 nM. The ratio of affinities towards both subtypes was maintained when the scFv was converted to IgG.
